policy: fewest parameters within 0.5 days of best validation MAE
estimate_caveat: Informal estimate: validation MAE plus one day, rounded up. Not measured, not a confidence bound; ten-model selection reuses validation and can be optimistic.
accuracy_size_reason: 16,16 has the lowest observed validation MAE among the ten fixed-seed models and 385 parameters; 64,64 uses 4609 parameters with slightly worse validation MAE. No accuracy was traded away on this split.
overfitting_discussion: Selected train MAE 4.815988 and validation MAE 5.308265 give a 0.492277-day gap. The 64,64 gap is 1.609487 days despite lower training error and no validation gain, consistent with greater overfitting. Poorer single-layer runs have high training and validation error, so their larger MAEs alone are not evidence of overfitting. Single-seed results do not establish robust rankings.
user_unseen_estimate: Requested after model selection; not supplied at verification time. The recorded 7-day value is Codex’s informal estimate.
